g.text: C Common active-deactivation recovery baseline and separation maps: not measured yet
This checkpoint contains the 15-case linear clock pilot only. No full linear or ring recovery grid is inferred.
The basal ring coefficient has no future separation; a separation map needs the same kick on declared challenged states.

g.text: Figure 2 · Ring correspondence and local response
Continued review sheet 1 of 2 · retained measurements plus an explicit recovery-map gap
13 independently prepared pairs at C = 2L: width/amount double; peak and matched-cue gain agree.
Baseline input matching: endpoint support 3 ↔ full ring support 6. The retained finite challenges below use full support 3.
One fixed 0–3 scale: within-size gain varies by <0.09% across eligible placements. Numbered cells link to sheet 2.
Rows are discrete sampled circumferences; × = 198 cue/core overlaps; dark gray = 17 unavailable Holmes C80 basals.
Native input/time units are not calibrated across models.
